TraceRook walkthrough

App screens show TraceRook's built-in sample data.

Coding agents run real commands on your Mac. Most are routine. A few aren't.

TraceRook checks every tool call before it runs. Routine work goes straight through. But when an agent tries to upload your SSH key, a local rule blocks it before it executes.

Clear-cut risks are decided on your Mac, in milliseconds. When an action is ambiguous, Claude weighs the local signals against the task you gave your agent.

When it's your call, TraceRook pauses the agent and shows you the exact action, the evidence, and a deadline. Allow once releases that one call, and nothing more.

Every session keeps its timeline and evidence, in a native Mac app.

And your code stays on your Mac. Claude sees categories and signal codes, never your commands or files.

TraceRook. Let your agent build, and keep the next move in check. Request an invitation at tracerook.dev.
